item.title: fix(channels/turn): clear pending history on error paths (#123193)
item.summary: fix(channels/turn): clear pending history on error paths (#123193) Failed channel turns could leave caller-owned pending group history in the next prompt. Finalize it on every terminal path, and filter Telegram rolling context while preserving explicit reply ancestry. Co-authored-by: SunnyShu0925 Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
